The accepted '~35 deg structural sway floor' is CADENCE-SPECIFIC, an artifact of 25 Hz / 1.5 deg-per-tick slew quantization jerk: re-measured 31.5 deg at 25 Hz primitive (validates the probe against the known floor) vs 13.7 at 100 Hz primitive and 13.5/5.4 at 100 Hz mesh.
